violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface Deep fat fryer, cooking equipment etc. was not cleaned as frequently as required.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory/station needs cleaned. of debris.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities Floors were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Secondary container of poisonous or toxic material was not clearly identified to indicated contents. - Several spray bottles need labeling to identify contents.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Wall mounted fan requires more frequent cleaning. Has an accumulation of dust on the fan guards. - Doors and fronts of coolers and upright freezers in need of cleaning. - Handle of prep table door in need of repair.
